assignments.title_en: Phones away all day? Smartphones in secondary schools
assignments.title_he: בלי טלפון כל היום? סמארטפונים בבית הספר התיכון
assignments.prompt: Argue whether secondary schools should require students to lock away their smartphones for the whole school day, including breaks, and respond to opposing views.

assignments.title_en: Fare-free public transport: should cities stop charging?
assignments.title_he: תחבורה ציבורית בחינם: האם ערים צריכות לוותר על דמי הנסיעה?
assignments.prompt: Argue whether cities should make local buses and trains free for everyone, paid for from city funds, and respond to opposing views.

assignments.title_en: The four-day week: progress or pressure?
assignments.title_he: שבוע עבודה של ארבעה ימים: התקדמות או לחץ?
assignments.prompt: Argue whether employers should move to a four-day working week with no reduction in pay, and respond to opposing views.

assignments.title_en: AI writing assistants and graded schoolwork
assignments.title_he: עוזרי כתיבה מבוססי בינה מלאכותית ועבודות להגשה
assignments.prompt: Argue whether secondary schools should allow students to use AI writing assistants when they produce graded written assignments, and respond to opposing views.

assignments.title_en: Homes or parkland? Building on urban green space
assignments.title_he: דיור או פארק? בנייה על שטחים ירוקים בעיר
assignments.prompt: Argue whether cities facing housing shortages should build homes on part of their urban parkland, using the fictional case of Halvarden, and respond to opposing views.

assignments.title_en: Holiday rentals and the people who live there
assignments.prompt: Argue whether popular tourist cities should strictly limit short-term holiday rentals in residential neighbourhoods, using the fictional case of Port Averly, and respond to opposing views.

assignments.title_en: Remote by default? The future of office work
assignments.prompt: Argue whether companies with office-based jobs should make remote work the default, so that employees come to the office only when there is a specific reason, and respond to opposing views.

assignments.title_en: A minimum age for social media
assignments.prompt: Argue a defensible, original position on whether governments should set a legal minimum age of 16 for social media accounts, drawing on and evaluating the illustrative sources, and respond to opposing views.

assignments.title_en: Public money and crewed space exploration
assignments.prompt: Argue a defensible, original position on whether public money should fund crewed space exploration while urgent problems on Earth remain unsolved, drawing on and evaluating the illustrative sources, and respond to opposing views.

assignments.title_en: Who should pay for a degree?
assignments.title_he: מי צריך לממן את התואר הראשון?
assignments.prompt: Argue a defensible, original position on who should pay for undergraduate university education (students, the state or a combination) and on what terms, drawing on and evaluating the illustrative sources, and respond to opposing views.
